title: Flow Detail Lod Channel Names Visible
description: On detail LOD the names of the channels should be visible in the flow editor.
summary: Channel names are now visible at detail LOD. `DagDrawLod::shows_port_labels` includes Detail alongside Micro. Port label anchors (left/right aligned, compact font) are serialized into `label_overlay_paint_state_json` and painted by the FlowCanvas Canvas 2D overlay, matching the existing node-label workaround for invisible Vello text.
